outcome: length of first phase of labor
length of second phase of labor
cohort: The study included 698 singleton pregnancies whose height and weight were followed from the first trimester and whose deliveries were monitored.
finding: As pre-pregnancy body mass index and gestational weight gain increased, the rates of cesarean section, interventional delivery, and neonatal intensive care unit admissions increased.
mod_finding: Increased pre-pregnancy body mass index and gestational weight gain were associated with higher rates of cesarean section and interventional delivery.
